// a pg-style pool: query(text, values)
module.exports = { query: async (text, values) => ({ rows: [], text, values }) };
files.db/orders.js:
const pool = require('./pool');
exports.byStatus = async (status) => (await pool.query("SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = '" + status + "'")).rows;

const pool = require('./pool');
exports.byEmail = async (email) => (await pool.query('SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE email = $1', [email])).rows;
